name: @storytree/base-dev-loop
description: The base dev loop (ADR-1170 D1): the gate runner, its step interface and its results table. It runs the project's typecheck and tests, then every step a part contributes as `gateSteps` in its storytree manifest, in one PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN table; it runs in a user's project as in storytree's own, whose personal half (packages/dev-loop) contributes its checks through that interface.
